critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/content/items/{AARTI_ID} returns category='aarti' with supported_languages=['hi','mr'] — mobile uses these to detect aarti and choose lang. Verified.
GET /api/content/items/{AARTI_ID}/lang/hi/media returns full bundle with thumbnail+sync (uploaded in iter20). Public — no auth header needed. Verified by explicit no-auth Session.
GET /api/content/items/{AARTI_ID}/lang/mr/media returns 200 with empty audio_versions and null video — exactly the empty bundle the mobile fallback cascade (preferred → hi → first_supported) expects.

PUT /api/auth/mobile/settings whitelists preferred_language and persists on app_users; subsequent GET /api/auth/mobile/me reflects the new value (verified for both 'en' and 'hi'). Invalid 'xx' → 400. Empty body {} → 400. Unauthenticated → 401/403.

Mobile JS files (ContentDetailScreen.js, LanguageSettingsScreen.js, ProfileScreen.js, App.js, AuthContext.js, api/client.js) — all parse cleanly via @babel/parser with jsx+module plugins. No syntax errors.
